text:
Situation: Sodium chloride 9 mg/mL, 50 mL at Corvale East has 349 units and 9.2 days on hand. Corvale Lakeside holds 117 units with 16.7 days on hand. Other Corvale sites have multiple sodium chloride presentations with 8.9 to 16.1 days on hand. FDA's records show sodium chloride is not on the current shortage list as of 2026-10-21; an earlier shortage was first posted on 2018-06-21 and has since been resolved.

Why (FDA record): FDA's records show sodium chloride is not on the current shortage list as of 2026-10-21; an earlier shortage was first posted on 2018-06-21 and has since been resolved.

Our position: Internal supply is adequate across the system. A targeted transfer can normalize days on hand at Corvale East without creating risk at Corvale Lakeside. Alternate manufacturers are available and not on FDA's shortage list.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 18 units of sodium chloride 9 mg/mL, 50 mL from Corvale Lakeside to Corvale East — requires pharmacy director approval of the transfer request.
2. Place purchase orders with Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA Inc. — requires buyer approval.
3. Place purchase orders with Medefil, Inc. — requires buyer approval.
4. Place purchase orders with Becton Dickinson and Company — requires buyer approval.

Not recommended: No additional actions at this time.
